echo "Candidates for deletion (>30 days):"

# Compute total size to be removed
DEL_SIZE_BYTES=0
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -z "$f" ] && continue
  sz=$(stat -c %s "$f" || echo 0)
  DEL_SIZE_BYTES=$((DEL_SIZE_BYTES + sz))
done <<< "$DEL_LIST"

HUMAN_SIZE=$(python3 - <<'PY'
import sys
b=int(sys.stdin.read())
for u in ['B','KB','MB','GB','TB']:
    if b<1024 or u=='TB':
        print(f"{b:.1f} {u}" if u!='B' else f"{b} {u}")
        break
    b/=1024
PY
<<< "$DEL_SIZE_BYTES")

# Delete the files
REMOVED_COUNT=0
REMOVED_NAMES=""
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -z "$f" ] && continue
  sudo rm -f -- "$f"
  REMOVED_COUNT=$((REMOVED_COUNT + 1))
  base=$(basename "$f")
  if [ -z "$REMOVED_NAMES" ]; then REMOVED_NAMES="$base"; else REMOVED_NAMES="$REMOVED_NAMES, $base"; fi
done <<< "$DEL_LIST"

# Compress any remaining uncompressed files older than 7 days (exclude current active logs by size change heuristic)
COMPRESS_LIST=$(find /var/log/agent-platform -type f -name '*.log' -mtime +7 -printf '%p\n' | sort || true)
COMPRESSED_COUNT=0
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -z "$f" ] && continue
  # Skip active logs that are still being written: only compress if file hasn't changed in >7 days as per mtime, and not .log without rotation role like gateway.log
  # We already filtered by mtime >7; also skip gateway.log (current) just in case
  if [ "$(basename "$f")" = "gateway.log" ]; then continue; fi
  sudo gzip -9n -- "$f" || true
  COMPRESSED_COUNT=$((COMPRESSED_COUNT + 1))
done <<< "$COMPRESS_LIST"

sudo du -sh /var/log/agent-platform

sudo df -h /var | sed -n '1,2p'"]
